editorial: Open source interface design (UI design) and data management tools stand out in today's technology agenda. New libraries, especially in the field of model context and time-series forecasting, focus on optimizing developers' data processing processes.

items.title: palmier-io/palmier-pro
items.summary: Palmier Pro was developed as a macOS-based video editor that integrates artificial intelligence-supported editing tools. This application, written in Swift language, aims to use generative AI features in video processing processes.

items.title: penpot/penpot
items.summary: Penpot is an open source design tool developed to strengthen collaboration between designers and software developers. Written in Clojure language, the platform aims to integrate design processes with code-based work flows.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage is an open source agent-based system that turns AI-powered coding assistants into a comprehensive video production studio. This Python-based platform automates video production processes with 12 different pipelines and more than 500 agent skills.

items.title: tursodatabase/turso
items.summary: Turso offers an in-process SQL database that is compatible with SQLite. This system, developed in Rust language, simplifies data management processes by integrating into application processes.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.summary: Codebase-memory-mcp offers high-performance code intelligence by indexing code bases on a permanent knowledge graph. Developed in C language, this server supports 158 programming languages, reduces query times to below milliseconds and reduces token usage.

items.title: google-research/timesfm
items.summary: The Time Series Foundation Model, developed by Google Research, offers a pre-trained architecture for forecasting tasks. This model is trained on large-scale datasets to analyze time series data and produce future predictions.

items.title: twentyhq/twenty
items.summary: Twenty is an open source customer relationship management (CRM) platform developed with artificial intelligence-driven features. Written in TypeScript, the project aims to offer a modern and flexible alternative to traditional enterprise software.

items.title: Kong/insomnia
items.summary: Insomnia is an open source application programming interface (API) client that supports GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, SSE and gRPC protocols. Users can manage and test network requests with cloud, local storage, and Git integration options.

items.title: chopratejas/headroom
items.summary: Headroom reduces token usage by 60 to 95 percent by compressing log files, tool outputs, and information retrieval (RAG) fragments sent to large language models (LLMs). The tool, which can be used as a library, proxy and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, provides cost efficiency while maintaining model performance.

items.title: jamiepine/voicebox
items.summary: Voicebox is an open source artificial intelligence voice studio that allows users to perform voice cloning, dictation and content creation. Developed with the TypeScript language, this platform offers comprehensive tools to manage audio processing processes in the native environment.

items.title: Kilo-Org/kilocode
items.summary: Kilo is an all-in-one agent-based engineering platform that automates software development processes. It aims to accelerate the creation, distribution and development processes of software projects thanks to its open source coding agent.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: This repository, shared by Matt Pocock, offers skill packages that enable software developers to manage artificial intelligence assistants with structured commands. Users automate complex development processes with these ready-made instructions, accessible directly via the Claude directory.

items.title: withastro/flue
items.summary: Developed by the Astro team, Flue offers a TypeScript-based sandbox agent framework. It allows software developers to create artificial intelligence agents in secure and isolated environments.

items.title: owainlewis/awesome-artificial-intelligence
items.summary: Awesome-artificial-intelligence repository collects trainings, books, video lessons and academic articles in the field of artificial intelligence in a single center. This resource offers a comprehensive curriculum and literature archive for those who want to structure the learning process.

items.title: pppscn/SmsForwarder
items.summary: SmsForwarder is a tool that forwards text messages, calls and application notifications on Android devices to different messaging platforms or webhooks within the framework of specified rules. This software, which allows users to remotely manage their devices and access data such as battery status and contacts, was developed with the Kotlin language.

items.title: 1jehuang/jcode
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, jcode offers a framework for testing and evaluating coding-oriented artificial intelligence agents. It provides a standard infrastructure to measure the performance of agents used in software development processes.

items.title: SMPTE Makes Its Standards Freely Accessible
items.summary: The Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers (SMPTE) has made its media technology standards freely available to the global community. This step aims to ensure wider adoption of the digital media standards library across the industry.

items.title: Loupe – A iOS app that raises awareness about what native apps can see
items.summary: Loupe is an iOS application that aims to increase user awareness by visualizing what data native apps can access on the device. The software transparently reports the data access processes carried out by applications in the background.

items.title: DOS Game "F-15 Strike Eagle II" reversing project needs DOS test pilots
items.summary: The reverse engineering project of the F-15 Strike Eagle II game is looking for test pilots to verify the software's operability in different DOS environments. The work aims to preserve the classic game's source code by adapting it to modern systems.

items.title: Renting a sewing machine from the library
items.summary: Libraries in Finland are transforming the traditional book-focused service model by lending out a wide range of items, from sewing machines to drill sets. This application combines the sharing economy model, which aims to reduce consumption habits, with library infrastructure.

items.title: Temporary Cloudflare accounts for AI agents
items.summary: Cloudflare offers an infrastructure that allows the creation of temporary cloud accounts so that artificial intelligence agents can work safely. This system simplifies the authorization processes of agents and enables them to work with limited access permissions for a limited time.

items.title: yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF
items.summary: The Gemma-4-12B-coder model is a text generation model optimized for coding tasks. This structure, presented in GGUF format, has been optimized with quantization techniques to run more efficiently on local hardware.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model focused on text-generation. This model, which has reached a wide user base on the HuggingFace platform, offers text generation capabilities in natural language processing tasks.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3
items.summary: MiniMax-M3, developed by MiniMaxAI, is a multimodal model that produces text output by processing visual and textual inputs. The system supports complex content creation processes by analyzing different types of data simultaneously.

items.title: WeiboAI/VibeThinker-3B
items.summary: VibeThinker-3B, developed by WeiboAI, is a compact language model focused on text generation. Its 3 billion parameter structure offers an efficient alternative for text generation tasks with low computational cost.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K2.7-Code
items.summary: Kimi-K2.7-Code, developed by Moonshot AI, is a multimodal model that performs code generation by processing visual and text inputs. It aims to provide text-based solutions by analyzing visual data in software development processes.

Artificial intelligence technology that can produce new content such as text, visuals or audio from scratch using the data it learns.
Autonomous system that can make decisions on its own and take steps to achieve goals without human intervention.
A series of interconnected stages through which data is processed until it becomes a result.
Special abilities or tools that AI has to perform specific tasks.
The execution of an operation directly within the current program's own workspace, without being transferred to another location.
A data model that presents the relationships between information by connecting them like a network structure.
Words or character snippets that artificial intelligence uses when processing texts.
A comprehensive artificial intelligence model that can predict future trends by analyzing changes in historical numerical data.
Digital management system where companies monitor their communication with customers and sales processes.
A bridge that allows two different software to talk to each other and exchange data.
Artificial intelligence models trained with huge data that can understand human language and produce text.
A method that allows artificial intelligence to obtain information from current and private documents instead of its own memory when producing answers.
An intermediary server that forwards requests on the Internet on your behalf and hides your identity.
A protocol that enables artificial intelligence models to connect to different data sources and tools in a standard way.
Technology that analyzes a person's voice and makes them say new sentences as if they were that person.
